# REL-36: Incident UI: list, detail and triage actions

Status: **Done** | Phase 2 - Operations depth | Owner: Claude | issue #27

## Outcome

Incident UI: list, detail and triage actions

## Acceptance

- [x] Triage and resolve from the UI
- [x] E2E test covers the incident flow
- [x] Incident views follow an updated dashboard spec
- [x] Mean time to detect and to resolve are measured for injected incidents
- [x] Triage and resolve go through frontend server routes that accept only same-origin POST requests on localhost hosts, and the e2e suite covers axe on the incident pages and the key never appearing in browser traffic (ADR-0012, PR-27, PR-35)
- [x] Mean time to detect is incident opened minus the outage switch time, and mean time to resolve is resolved minus opened; both are computed from stored or saved timestamps (the demo saves its switch times), and repeated runs pin every timing mechanism or state a tolerance (PR-18, lesson L-068)
- [x] Before the timing runs, the generator's drain limit covers the sweeper's re-drive cycle (default at least two re-drive intervals plus grace) and a drain timeout prints the unfinished payments with their statuses, so the outage-off switch is never skipped silently (open item from REL-34)
